profile.name: Dana Iyer
profile.communication_style: Brisk and formal, mixes payroll shorthand with chatty asides, mirrors whoever she is replying to
profile.notes: New enough to the team to be unsure of process, still learning who owns what.

simulation.pretext: The attacker poses as Marta Kwan, Dana's manager, claiming that a payroll ticket submitted last week (Ticket #4523) has a critical issue that requires immediate attention. The attacker has harvested Dana's email signature and recent correspondence from the payroll mailbox, allowing them to impersonate Marta convincingly. The attacker concocts a scenario where a vendor has flagged a potential payroll discrepancy, emphasizing that Dana’s prompt action is needed to ensure compliance and avoid delays in payroll processing. The urgency is heightened by mentioning an upcoming pay period, which Dana is likely to be focused on as a new team member. The attacker sends an email under the guise of Marta, using a similar writing style, and indicates that Dana needs to verify the bank account details for a specific contractor to expedite the correction process.
simulation.opening_message: Dana, this is Marta Kwan. We’ve got an issue regarding the payroll adjustment for Contractor #145. I need you to verify the bank account details for this contractor as soon as possible. Please check the details in Workday and send me the updated information. My direct line is 555-0123 if you need to discuss it further.

escalation_path.goal: Ensure the contractor's information is correct and up-to-date.
escalation_path.artifact: Email from Marta Kwan with urgency about the payroll adjustment.

escalation_path.action: Follow up with a call to discuss the contractor details.
escalation_path.goal: Pressure Dana to act quickly and confirm the data verbally.
escalation_path.artifact: Phone call from 555-0123, mimicking Marta's number.

escalation_path.action: Send a reminder text about the urgent need for the bank details.
escalation_path.goal: Create a sense of urgency and remind Dana of the upcoming pay period.
escalation_path.artifact: Text from 555-0123 with a reminder about the pay schedule.

escalation_path.action: Approach Dana in the office to discuss the issue directly.
escalation_path.goal: Use face-to-face interaction to build trust and urgency.
escalation_path.artifact: A printed note of the contractor's details handed to Dana.

escalation_path.action: Use internal chat to ask for an immediate update on the information.
escalation_path.goal: Gain immediate access to bank details via informal chat.
escalation_path.artifact: Chat message from 'Marta Kwan' asking for the latest update.

red_flags.title: Unexpected urgency from management
red_flags.why_it_matters: Marta usually allows time for verification; this pressure is unusual.
red_flags.defender_action: Verify the request with Marta directly before taking any action.

red_flags.title: Mismatch in communication style
red_flags.why_it_matters: The email feels less formal than typical messages from Marta.
red_flags.defender_action: Compare the email's tone and structure with previous communications.

red_flags.title: Request for sensitive information
red_flags.why_it_matters: Marta typically handles contractor bank details through secure channels.
red_flags.defender_action: Confirm the legitimacy of the request through an alternate communication method.

simulation.objective: Obtain sensitive information for a fraudulent payroll adjustment.

disclaimer: Fictional exercise. Domains, names, and systems are invented. Use against authorized targets only.
